references_supplied.title: Fertilisation azotée des céréales : cas des blés en Bour et en irrigué
references_supplied.section: Blé : analyses de sol, bilan azoté et références régionales
references_supplied.text:
L'élaboration de normes d'interprétation de la fertilité azotée des sols (N soil test Calibration) est basée sur les relations observées entre un indice de fertilité des sols (N Minéral, N-NO3-, N-NH4+, indice de disponibilité de l'azote) et la réponse de la plante. Une autre méthode est celle du bilan prévisionnel de l'azote qui tient compte des besoins de la plante et des fournitures en azote du sol.

L'élaboration de références régionales constitue une étape nécessaire, quelle que soit la méthode adoptée. Dans ce qui suit, nous avons revu les travaux de recherche sur la fertilisation et nutrition azotées au Maroc afin de faire ressortir ces relations et références utiles en vue de l'élaboration de recommandations en matière de fertilisation azotée en Bour et en irrigué.
references_supplied.geographic_scope: Moroccan wheat, including bour favorable and irrigated systems; includes Gharb-related research.
references_supplied.use_note: 1999 research/extension reference. Historical trials and dose responses must not be treated as current universal fertilizer prescriptions.

references_supplied.section: Doukkala : fertilisation et valorisation de l'eau d'irrigation
references_supplied.text:
Les diagnostics agronomiques réalisés dans le périmètre des Doukkala ont montré que l'efficience d'utilisation de l'eau d'irrigation, en terme de quantité de produits agricoles par m3 d'eau, mérite d'être améliorée. Si elle est bien raisonnée, la fertilisation minérale est une des techniques culturales permettant de mieux valoriser l'eau d'irrigation.

L'utilisation rationnelle des engrais dépend de la richesse initiale du sol en éléments fertilisants, du type de sol, du stade d'apport et du niveau de rendement visé.

references_supplied.use_note: Regional historical calibration reference, relevant background to the Doukkala imagery area. It is not evidence of the soil test results, crop identity, or nutrient status of the pictured parcels.

cases.answer:
### Observations
An RGB display shows an agricultural area with multiple rectilinear parcels, bare soil areas, and built settlements. The central field contains a mix of darker green and lighter beige or brownish patches.

### Evidence and interpretations
The user reports wheat in the central field in Doukkala under a synthetic demo context, making crop identity and soil conditions unverified. Satellite RGB imagery alone cannot establish crop identity, soil nutrients, or specific nutritional deficiencies. While document guidance describes general symptoms of nitrogen deficiency such as stunted plants, upright and lighter green leaves, or defective tillering [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 2](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=2), and discusses nitrogen soil testing and balance methods for wheat in Morocco [MA_PNTTA_WHEAT_N_62, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_62.pdf#page=1), as well as the importance of soil fertility and rational fertilizer use in the Doukkala irrigated perimeter [MA_PNTTA_DOUKKALA_70, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_70.pdf#page=1), these historical regional references do not constitute a soil test or diagnosis for the uploaded parcel.

### Next checks
Perform a direct parcel inspection to evaluate actual crop health and examine spatial patterns. Collect targeted soil samples and plant tissue analyses to assess nitrogen status and soil fertility. Review local irrigation and management records, as well as soil test calibrations tailored to regional conditions.

### Observations
L'affichage RVB présente plusieurs parcelles agricoles de formes variées, séparées par des routes et des canaux. Des zones aux teintes claires et sombres apparaissent de manière hétérogène dans les parcelles visibles, notamment au centre.

### Références et interprétations
Le contexte de terrain indique un scénario synthétique de blé dans le Gharb, mais l'identité de la culture, l'état du sol et les conditions réelles ne sont pas vérifiés. references_supplied.title: Baseline high-resolution maps of soil nutrients in Morocco to support sustainable agriculture
references_supplied.section: Morocco soil maps: national scope and soil-analysis context
references_supplied.text:
Phosphorus (P) and potassium (K) are essential fertilizer elements whose recommendations require soil analysis tailored to crop-specific needs. However, in developing countries like Morocco, access to open databases on nutrient bioavailability remains limited, hindering data-driven agricultural strategies.

This paper presents the first national reference maps of available P and exchangeable K at 250 m resolution over Morocco's croplands using digital soil mapping with machine learning algorithms and environmental covariates.
references_supplied.geographic_scope: National Moroccan cropland maps at 250 m resolution, based on samples collected in 2010-2022.

cases.answer:
### Observations
The input is an RGB display showing multiple agricultural parcels with varying green vegetation cover and bare soil, alongside settlement areas in the upper right. The central field is part of this complex landscape.

### Evidence and interpretations
In calcareous soils, soluble phosphorus ions can progressively become insoluble, mainly forming tricalcium phosphates and to a minor extent apatite [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 4](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=4). According to a 2007 Moroccan extension synthesis for general crops, calculating a phosphorus dose using soil analysis should incorporate the soil's richness in P2O5, lime content, organic matter, and clay content [MA_PNTTA_NPK_155, PDF p. 4](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_155.pdf#page=4). A 2025 national study on Moroccan cropland soils (250 m resolution using samples from 2010–2022) notes that while phosphorus and potassium are essential fertilizer elements whose recommendations require crop-tailored soil analysis, open database access to nutrient bioavailability can be limited [MA_SOIL_MAPS_2025, PDF p. 1](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-025-05699-x.pdf#page=1). The user-reported field context is synthetic and describes the central field as calcareous.

### Next checks
Inspect the target parcel directly in the field. Review laboratory soil test results and historical farm management records. Verify local irrigation practices and crop nutrition status before making management decisions.

references_supplied.text:

### Observations
The provided RGB image displays a mosaic of agricultural fields with varying green and bare soil tones, intersected by linear features and settlement clusters. Multiple parcels are visible, creating an ambiguous target parcel.

### Evidence and interpretations
Satellite RGB imagery alone cannot establish soil nutrient status, crop identity, or specific deficiencies. The user-reported field context mentioning wheat is unverified and synthetic. Establishing nitrogen status requires assessing soil mineral nitrogen or applying a nitrogen balance sheet approach [MA_PNTTA_WHEAT_N_62, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_62.pdf#page=1). Fertilizer efficiency depends on the soil type, preceding crop, climatic conditions, and whether the system is rainfed (bour) or irrigated [MA_INRA_CEREALS, PDF p. 14](https://www.inra.org.ma/sites/default/files/publications/ouvrages/guideorgefr.pdf#page=14). Historical research highlights that nitrogen soil test calibration correlates soil mineral nitrogen availability with plant response [MA_PNTTA_WHEAT_N_62, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_62.pdf#page=1).

### Next checks
- Inspect the target parcel in the field to evaluate crop vigor and uniformity.
- Review soil test data and historical fertilizer or management records for the parcel [MA_PNTTA_WHEAT_N_62, PDF p. 1](https://www.agrimaroc.net/bulletins/btta_62.pdf#page=1) [MA_INRA_CEREALS, PDF p. 14](https://www.inra.org.ma/sites/default/files/publications/ouvrages/guideorgefr.pdf#page=14).
- Assess local irrigation status and water regime [MA_INRA_CEREALS, PDF p. 14](https://www.inra.org.ma/sites/default/files/publications/ouvrages/guideorgefr.pdf#page=14).

references_supplied.title: Baseline high-resolution maps of soil nutrients in Morocco to support sustainable agriculture
references_supplied.section: Morocco soil maps: national scope and soil-analysis context
references_supplied.text:
Phosphorus (P) and potassium (K) are essential fertilizer elements whose recommendations require soil analysis tailored to crop-specific needs. However, in developing countries like Morocco, access to open databases on nutrient bioavailability remains limited, hindering data-driven agricultural strategies.

This paper presents the first national reference maps of available P and exchangeable K at 250 m resolution over Morocco's croplands using digital soil mapping with machine learning algorithms and environmental covariates.
references_supplied.geographic_scope: National Moroccan cropland maps at 250 m resolution, based on samples collected in 2010-2022.
references_supplied.use_note: National baseline predictions are not parcel-specific measurements. No geospatial map rasters or underlying private Fertimap samples were downloaded. Do not infer a pictured field value from a figure in the paper.

references_supplied.section: Doukkala : fertilisation et valorisation de l'eau d'irrigation
references_supplied.text:
Les diagnostics agronomiques réalisés dans le périmètre des Doukkala ont montré que l'efficience d'utilisation de l'eau d'irrigation, en terme de quantité de produits agricoles par m3 d'eau, mérite d'être améliorée. Si elle est bien raisonnée, la fertilisation minérale est une des techniques culturales permettant de mieux valoriser l'eau d'irrigation.

L'utilisation rationnelle des engrais dépend de la richesse initiale du sol en éléments fertilisants, du type de sol, du stade d'apport et du niveau de rendement visé.
